#include <iostream>
#include <functional>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;
    if (w < 4) {
        std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    auto invalid = [w](int r) -> bool { return r > 1 && r != w - 1; };
    while (m > 0) {
        int remainder = m % w;
        if (invalid(remainder)) {
            std::cout << "NO" << std::endl;
            return 0;
        }
        m = (++m) / w;
    }
    std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
